correctness.rationale: Finite T0 spaces are Alexandrov upper-set spaces of their specialization posets. In the published greatest-element poset L-algebra, ideals are nonempty upper sets. Prime ideals are exactly complements of principal downsets: the forward direction follows from upperness, and the complement of any prime upper set has a unique maximal point. The spectrum basic-open formula then pulls back U_I to I intersect T.
